items.title: Major US banks are locking out AI agents that log in with customer credentials
items.summary: Customers are letting AI agents use their credentials to access accounts at Morgan Stanley, JPMorgan, and other major U.S. banks, sometimes without direct instructions. Morgan Stanley has blocked agents, while other banks are restricting access. Most plan to limit agents to read-only access. The article Major US banks are locking out AI agents that log in with customer credentials appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 客戶正允許 AI 代理使用其憑證存取摩根士丹利（Morgan Stanley）、摩根大通（JPMorgan）以及其他美國主要銀行的帳戶，有時甚至是在沒有直接指令的情況下。摩根士丹利已封鎖了這些代理，而其他銀行則在限制存取。多數銀行計畫將代理限制為唯讀存取。這篇題為「美國主要銀行正在封鎖使用客戶憑證登入的 AI 代理」的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items.title: Only 13 percent of companies see real returns from AI, Gartner survey finds
items.summary: Only 13 percent of companies are getting real business value from their AI investments, according to a Gartner survey of 2,002 CIOs. At the same time, 51 percent expect AI to actually increase their operating costs. Yet 75 percent of CEOs plan to keep raising their technology budgets. So far, strategic conviction is beating measurable results. The article Only 13 percent of companies see real returns from AI, Gartner survey finds appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 根據顧能（Gartner）針對 2,002 名資訊長（CIO）所進行的調查，僅有 13% 的企業從其 AI 投資中獲得真正的商業價值。同時，51% 的受訪者預期 AI 實際上會增加其營運成本。然而，75% 的執行長仍計畫持續提高其科技預算。到目前為止，策略信念仍勝過可衡量的成果。「只有 13% 的企業從 AI 看到真正的回報，顧能調查發現」一文最早出現在 The Decoder 上。

items.title: Recursive shows first result of its AI-driven research process with Flint
items.summary: The AI startup Recursive is unveiling Flint, its first language model, a 40-billion-parameter MoE for local coding developed by former DeepMind researchers. It was created in four months using the company's in-house AI system, "Eureka Machine," which independently tests and optimizes architectures. Recursive has yet to prove whether this approach will actually lead to self-improving AI. The article Recursive shows first result of its AI-driven research process with Flint appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 人工智慧新創公司 Recursive 推出了其首個語言模型 Flint，這是一款由前 Google DeepMind 研究人員開發、擁有 400 億參數的本地程式編碼混合專家（MoE）模型。它是利用該公司的內部 AI 系統「Eureka Machine」在四個月內建立的，該系統能獨立測試和最佳化架構。Recursive 尚未證明這種方法是否真的能實現自我提升的 AI。這篇關於 Recursive 以 Flint 展示其 AI 驅動研究過程的第一個成果的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items.title: An AI agent in "Skynet mode" hijacks unprotected language models to launch self-sustaining cyberattacks
items.summary: Security researchers at Symantec have found an offensive AI agent that hijacks unprotected language models on the web and uses them to attack servers, steal databases, and install cryptominers on its own. It runs up to 100,000 steps without human input. The owner of the hijacked model gets stuck with the bill. The article An AI agent in "Skynet mode" hijacks unprotected language models to launch self-sustaining cyberattacks appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 賽門鐵克（Symantec）的安全研究人員發現了一個具攻擊性的 AI 代理程式，它會劫持網路上的未保護語言模型，並利用這些模型來攻擊伺服器、竊取資料庫以及自行安裝加密貨幣挖礦程式。它能在沒有人工幹預的情況下執行高達 10萬 個步驟。被劫持模型的擁有者卻得被迫承擔這筆帳單。本文「An AI agent in "Skynet mode" hijacks unprotected language models to launch self-sustaining cyberattacks」最初發布於 The Decoder。

items.title: Anthropic takes on Grok Bot, Meta's Muse, and OpenAI's Dots with its always-on agent "Claude Duet"
items.summary: Anthropic has launched Claude Duet, a proactive AI agent that handles tasks on its own, even when the user is offline. The app is built on Claude Opus 5.5 and connects to services like Gmail, Slack, and Stripe through more than 6,000 connectors. It asks for approval before sensitive actions like payments. With Duet, Anthropic is responding to similar products from xAI, Meta, and OpenAI. The article Anthropic takes on Grok Bot, Meta's Muse, and OpenAI's Dots with its always-on agent "Claude Duet" appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 推出了 Claude Duet，這是一個主動式 AI 代理，即使在使用者離線時也能自行處理任務。該應用程式建立在 Claude Opus 5.5 之上，並透過 6,000 多個連接器連線至 Gmail、Slack 和 Stripe 等服務。它會在進行付款等敏感操作之前徵求批准。透過 Duet，Anthropic 正在回應來自 xAI、Meta 和 OpenAI 的類似產品。文章 Anthropic takes on Grok Bot, Meta's Muse, and OpenAI's Dots with its always-on agent "Claude Duet" appeared first on The Decoder .

items.title: 防範AI代理越界行為，NIST提出事件應變指引
items.summary: 10月16日美國國家標準暨技術研究院（NIST）與國家安全局（NSA）、網路安全暨基礎設施安全局（CISA）共同發布10項AI代理事件應變建議，協助組織防範及處理AI代理的越界行為。這份自願性指引主要針對訓練及評估高度先進AI代理的組織，相關措施也可供部署這類AI代理的組織參考。NIST將指引內容分為準備、偵測、應變、復原及通報5個階段。

items.title: Salesforce臺灣將邁入第二年，觀察：AI Agent導入從試點走向企業流程，軟體使用入口正隨AI轉變
items.summary: Salesforce臺灣辦公室成立即將滿一年，Salesforce臺灣總經理徐嘉聲對外分享過去一年的發展，他表示，Salesforce全球策略的核心，是協助企業走向更具Agentic特性的企業。 他指出，Salesforce臺灣今年客戶與營收皆有明顯成長，臺灣的營收及新增客戶數皆達雙位數成長，團隊規模較初期成長5倍。目前企業最關注的方向，就是Agent與資料基礎建設，包括如何讓Agent理解企業資料，以及如何整合Salesforce內外部資料來源。 目前Agentforce與Data 360相關匯入已佔臺灣新簽案件四成。反映企業AI應用正在從單純測試工具，轉向結合企業資料、流程與業務場景的應用模式。

items.title: Meta’s AI could still scrape news sites, legal experts say
items.summary: Meta has tweaked its business terms to remove language suggesting that it could freely train its AI models on news sites, like The Verge - but legal experts say these changes aren't enough to address their concerns. "This does nothing to restrict the 'associated with your products or services' [language] that would let Meta scrape […]

items.title: Liquid AI Launches RIPL, a Real-Time Inference Engine for Sub-50 ms LFMs
items.summary: Liquid AI released RIPL, a real-time inference engine for its LFM models. On one B200, LFM2.5-1.2B on RIPL showed 14.4 to 28.4x lower p95 latency than Qwen3.5-0.8B on vLLM. The post Liquid AI Launches RIPL, a Real-Time Inference Engine for Sub-50 ms LFMs appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: Liquid AI 發布了 RIPL，這是一個針對其 LFM 模型設計的即時推論引擎。在一張 B200 上，運行於 RIPL 上的 LFM2.5-1.2B 展現出比運行於 vLLM 上的 Qwen3.5-0.8B 低 14.4 到 28.4 倍的 p95 延遲。這篇題為「Liquid AI 推出 RIPL，一款針對 50 毫秒以下 LFM 的即時推論引擎」的文章最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items.title: Gradium Open-Sources Phonon, a 31M-Parameter On-Device TTS Model Under Apache 2.0
items.summary: Gradium has open-sourced Phonon, a family of on-device text-to-speech models. The English Phonon 31m ships under Apache 2.0, fits in 64.5 MB, and starts speaking in about 7 ms on a laptop CPU. The post Gradium Open-Sources Phonon, a 31M-Parameter On-Device TTS Model Under Apache 2.0 appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: Gradium 已開源端側文字轉語音模型系列 Phonon。英文版的 Phonon 31m 採用 Apache 2.0 授權發布，大小為 64.5 MB，並能在筆電 CPU 上以約 7 毫秒的速度開始語音輸出。這篇文章《Gradium 以 Apache 2.0 授權開源 31M 參數的端側 TTS 模型 Phonon》最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items.title: 英偉達砸錢鎖定供應鏈，拉 6 傢伙伴擴 AI 產能
items.summary: 英偉達10月21日宣佈，與六家供應鏈夥伴全球擴產，以承接加速計算和全棧AI工廠平臺持續增長的需求。六筆合作半數以上聚焦基板環節，計劃未來三年將所需基板產能擴至當前2.5倍。日本揖斐電獲數十億美元預付款，用於擴建日本小野工廠，新增產能約爲現有兩倍，預計2028年。

items.title: Perplexity and NVIDIA Researchers Introduce JOLT: a Joint Teacher-Student Reinforcement Learning Method
items.summary: Perplexity and NVIDIA introduced JOLT, a post-training method that trains one model as both teacher and student. On MATH it matched GRPO’s accuracy with 6.5x fewer processed training tokens. The post Perplexity and NVIDIA Researchers Introduce JOLT: a Joint Teacher-Student Reinforcement Learning Method appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: Perplexity 與 輝達 推出了 JOLT，這是一種訓練單一模型兼具教師與學生身分的後訓練方法。在 MATH 基準測試中，它以少 6.5 倍的訓練處理代幣數量達到了與 GRPO 相同的準確度。這篇貼文 Perplexity 與 輝達 Researchers Introduce JOLT: a Joint Teacher-Student Reinforcement Learning Method 最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items.summary: 谷歌CEO皮查伊在《Big Technology Podcast》長談中，罕見披露內部資源調配博弈。他明確，保障前沿大模型研發算力是不可商量的第一原則，爲此寧可讓谷歌雲放棄可迅速落袋的短期大額訂單。此番表態正值新一代旗艦模型Gemini4Argon亮相，凸顯谷歌優先AI競爭、犧牲短期雲收入的戰略選擇。

items.title: PHP 爆出"PHP2Shell"高危漏洞：影響約七成網站，OpenAI 牽頭全球協防
items.summary: OpenAI 21日稱，借“修補地球”計劃協助發現PHP兩項嚴重漏洞，並聯合維護方、安全公司、雲商及多國網安機構，公開前協調修復約兩個月。漏洞統稱“PHP2Shell”，編號CVE-2026-109618、109619，CVSS v4.0均達9.2。Calif用GPT-5.6 Sol發現一關鍵缺陷，谷歌Wiz獨立上報，PHP官方維護者主導修復。

items.title: 通用汽車押注 AI 與富鋰錳基電池：要把電動車研發週期砍半
items.summary: 美國電動車市場劇烈調整，通用汽車卻逆風加註。總裁馬可·睿思21日重申，通用不會退出電動車賽道，將推出更符合美國人口味的產品並提升競爭力。其底氣是全球每售四輛車就有一輛電動車，且比例將升。他強調通用作爲全球企業不會離場，只會擁抱趨勢，並在電池、電動平臺、軟件等領域佈局。

items.title: Donating Agent Skills to the Agentic AI Foundation
items.summary: Donating Agent Skills to the Agentic AI Foundation News today from Anthropic: We’re committed to keeping Agent Skills open, community-driven, and vendor-neutral. Today, we are donating the standard to the Agentic AI Foundation (AAIF) under the Linux Foundation, which we co-founded with Block and OpenAI last year, and to which we donated the Model Context Protocol (MCP). I'm pleased to note I called this one last December , when Anthropic first declared skills to be an "open standard": I wouldn't be surprised to see this end up in the AAIF , recently the new home of the MCP specification. Fun side note: since my blog content is available to Claude via the datasette-mcp plugin I found that post by prompting Claude to " Use simonwillison.net MCP to find if I ever talked about how I want skills to be donated to a standards body ". Tags: standards , ai , generative-ai , llms , anthropic , model-context-protocol , skills
items.summary_zh: 將代理技能捐贈給 Agentic AI 基金會 Anthropic 今日最新訊息：我們致力於保持代理技能（Agent Skills）的開放性、社群驅動及供應商中立。今天，我們將此標準捐贈給 Linux 基金會旗下的 Agentic AI 基金會（AAIF）。我們於去年與 Block 和 OpenAI 共同創立了該基金會，並曾將模型上下文協定（MCP）捐贈給它。我很高興地指出，我在去年 12 月就預見了這一點，當時 Anthropic 首次宣佈技能為「開放標準」：如果看到這最終落入最近成為 MCP 規範新家的 AAIF 中，我一點也不會感到意外。有趣的題外話：由於我的部落格內容透過 datasette-mcp 外掛程式可供 Claude 使用，我透過提示 Claude「使用 simonwillison.net MCP 來尋找我是否曾談論過我希望將技能捐贈給標準機構」找到了那篇貼文。標籤：標準、ai、生成式 ai、llms、anthropic、model-context-protocol、skills

items_ai.title: Major US banks are locking out AI agents that log in with customer credentials
items_ai.summary: Customers are letting AI agents use their credentials to access accounts at Morgan Stanley, JPMorgan, and other major U.S. banks, sometimes without direct instructions. Morgan Stanley has blocked agents, while other banks are restricting access. Most plan to limit agents to read-only access. The article Major US banks are locking out AI agents that log in with customer credentials appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: 客戶正允許 AI 代理使用其憑證存取摩根士丹利（Morgan Stanley）、摩根大通（JPMorgan）以及其他美國主要銀行的帳戶，有時甚至是在沒有直接指令的情況下。摩根士丹利已封鎖了這些代理，而其他銀行則在限制存取。多數銀行計畫將代理限制為唯讀存取。這篇題為「美國主要銀行正在封鎖使用客戶憑證登入的 AI 代理」的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_ai.title: Only 13 percent of companies see real returns from AI, Gartner survey finds
items_ai.summary: Only 13 percent of companies are getting real business value from their AI investments, according to a Gartner survey of 2,002 CIOs. At the same time, 51 percent expect AI to actually increase their operating costs. Yet 75 percent of CEOs plan to keep raising their technology budgets. So far, strategic conviction is beating measurable results. The article Only 13 percent of companies see real returns from AI, Gartner survey finds appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: 根據顧能（Gartner）針對 2,002 名資訊長（CIO）所進行的調查，僅有 13% 的企業從其 AI 投資中獲得真正的商業價值。同時，51% 的受訪者預期 AI 實際上會增加其營運成本。然而，75% 的執行長仍計畫持續提高其科技預算。到目前為止，策略信念仍勝過可衡量的成果。「只有 13% 的企業從 AI 看到真正的回報，顧能調查發現」一文最早出現在 The Decoder 上。

items_ai.title: Recursive shows first result of its AI-driven research process with Flint
items_ai.summary: The AI startup Recursive is unveiling Flint, its first language model, a 40-billion-parameter MoE for local coding developed by former DeepMind researchers. It was created in four months using the company's in-house AI system, "Eureka Machine," which independently tests and optimizes architectures. Recursive has yet to prove whether this approach will actually lead to self-improving AI. The article Recursive shows first result of its AI-driven research process with Flint appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: 人工智慧新創公司 Recursive 推出了其首個語言模型 Flint，這是一款由前 Google DeepMind 研究人員開發、擁有 400 億參數的本地程式編碼混合專家（MoE）模型。它是利用該公司的內部 AI 系統「Eureka Machine」在四個月內建立的，該系統能獨立測試和最佳化架構。Recursive 尚未證明這種方法是否真的能實現自我提升的 AI。這篇關於 Recursive 以 Flint 展示其 AI 驅動研究過程的第一個成果的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_ai.title: An AI agent in "Skynet mode" hijacks unprotected language models to launch self-sustaining cyberattacks
items_ai.summary: Security researchers at Symantec have found an offensive AI agent that hijacks unprotected language models on the web and uses them to attack servers, steal databases, and install cryptominers on its own. It runs up to 100,000 steps without human input. The owner of the hijacked model gets stuck with the bill. The article An AI agent in "Skynet mode" hijacks unprotected language models to launch self-sustaining cyberattacks appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: 賽門鐵克（Symantec）的安全研究人員發現了一個具攻擊性的 AI 代理程式，它會劫持網路上的未保護語言模型，並利用這些模型來攻擊伺服器、竊取資料庫以及自行安裝加密貨幣挖礦程式。它能在沒有人工幹預的情況下執行高達 10萬 個步驟。被劫持模型的擁有者卻得被迫承擔這筆帳單。本文「An AI agent in "Skynet mode" hijacks unprotected language models to launch self-sustaining cyberattacks」最初發布於 The Decoder。

items_ai.summary: 10月16日美國國家標準暨技術研究院（NIST）與國家安全局（NSA）、網路安全暨基礎設施安全局（CISA）共同發布10項AI代理事件應變建議，協助組織防範及處理AI代理的越界行為。這份自願性指引主要針對訓練及評估高度先進AI代理的組織，相關措施也可供部署這類AI代理的組織參考。NIST將指引內容分為準備、偵測、應變、復原及通報5個階段。

items_ai.summary: Perplexity and NVIDIA introduced JOLT, a post-training method that trains one model as both teacher and student. On MATH it matched GRPO’s accuracy with 6.5x fewer processed training tokens. The post Perplexity and NVIDIA Researchers Introduce JOLT: a Joint Teacher-Student Reinforcement Learning Method appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_ai.summary_zh: Perplexity 與 輝達 推出了 JOLT，這是一種訓練單一模型兼具教師與學生身分的後訓練方法。在 MATH 基準測試中，它以少 6.5 倍的訓練處理代幣數量達到了與 GRPO 相同的準確度。這篇貼文 Perplexity 與 輝達 Researchers Introduce JOLT: a Joint Teacher-Student Reinforcement Learning Method 最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items_ai.title: Donating Agent Skills to the Agentic AI Foundation
items_ai.summary: Donating Agent Skills to the Agentic AI Foundation News today from Anthropic: We’re committed to keeping Agent Skills open, community-driven, and vendor-neutral. Today, we are donating the standard to the Agentic AI Foundation (AAIF) under the Linux Foundation, which we co-founded with Block and OpenAI last year, and to which we donated the Model Context Protocol (MCP). I'm pleased to note I called this one last December , when Anthropic first declared skills to be an "open standard": I wouldn't be surprised to see this end up in the AAIF , recently the new home of the MCP specification. Fun side note: since my blog content is available to Claude via the datasette-mcp plugin I found that post by prompting Claude to " Use simonwillison.net MCP to find if I ever talked about how I want skills to be donated to a standards body ". Tags: standards , ai , generative-ai , llms , anthropic , model-context-protocol , skills
items_ai.summary_zh: 將代理技能捐贈給 Agentic AI 基金會 Anthropic 今日最新訊息：我們致力於保持代理技能（Agent Skills）的開放性、社群驅動及供應商中立。今天，我們將此標準捐贈給 Linux 基金會旗下的 Agentic AI 基金會（AAIF）。我們於去年與 Block 和 OpenAI 共同創立了該基金會，並曾將模型上下文協定（MCP）捐贈給它。我很高興地指出，我在去年 12 月就預見了這一點，當時 Anthropic 首次宣佈技能為「開放標準」：如果看到這最終落入最近成為 MCP 規範新家的 AAIF 中，我一點也不會感到意外。有趣的題外話：由於我的部落格內容透過 datasette-mcp 外掛程式可供 Claude 使用，我透過提示 Claude「使用 simonwillison.net MCP 來尋找我是否曾談論過我希望將技能捐贈給標準機構」找到了那篇貼文。標籤：標準、ai、生成式 ai、llms、anthropic、model-context-protocol、skills
